liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The first set intensifies around this track and maintains that energy throughout [8]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-21.mtx.seamons.121045.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 180 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1976-06-21.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112191.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 178 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: The recording features a smooth, liquid quality with crystal clear audio fidelity; Jerry Garcia sounds awesome, and the band is described as being on point [8][18]
- **gd1976-06-21.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112171.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 179 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [5]. Said about its sound: The source shifts from soundboard to audience halfway through this song; The audience source remains active until the beginning of this track; All disc changes in the recording are described as being seamless [5][12]
- **gd1976-06-21.aud.digitalrbb.miller.112162.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: The recording is clear with nice balance, despite a sometimes loud crowd [17]

## Around the show

- A crowd member calls for a song at the end, a unique historical moment [9]
- The reviewer's parents first dated at the venue when it was a movie theater [16]
- Bob and Donna provide harmonies during this performance of the song [17]
- This performance starts a run of Tower shows, with the next night improving [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-21.mtx.seamons.121045.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Jubal H. Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) [1]. Also: Audio was transferred from master cassette via Apogee Ensemble to AIFF, then FLAC [1]
- **gd1976-06-21.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112191.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak -> AIFF [4]
- **gd1976-06-21.sbd.digitalrbb.miller.112171.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak -> AIFF [5]. Also: Charlie Miller is credited with applying a magic touch to this recording; Charlie Miller is credited with providing another masterful show for the archive; Digitalrbb supplied and digitized tapes, while Joe B. Jones helped pitch correct [5][10][11]
- **gd1976-06-21.aud.digitalrbb.miller.112162.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Stereo Microphone (Possibly Sony Microphone) -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) [6]
